# Toolmova

> Practical browser-based image tools in English, Bahasa Indonesia and Spanish.

## Language editions
- [English](https://toolmova.com/en/)
- [Bahasa Indonesia](https://toolmova.com/id/)
- [Español](https://toolmova.com/es/)

## Tools
- [Compress photo](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/compress-photo/)
- [JPG to 100 KB](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/compress-jpg-to-100kb/)
- [JPG to 200 KB](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/compress-jpg-to-200kb/)
- [Photo to 500 KB](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/compress-photo-to-500kb/)
- [Resize photo](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/resize-photo/)
- [3 × 4 cm photo](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/resize-photo-3x4/)
- [4 × 6 cm photo](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/resize-photo-4x6/)
- [Crop photo](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/crop-photo/)
- [PNG to JPG](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/png-to-jpg/)
- [Put two photos side by side](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/side-by-side-photos/)
- [Signature background remover](https://toolmova.com/en/image-tools/signature-background-remover/)
- [Kompres foto online](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/kompres-foto/)
- [Kompres JPG 100 KB](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/kompres-jpg-100-kb/)
- [Kompres JPG 200 KB](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/kompres-jpg-200-kb/)
- [Kompres foto 500 KB](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/kompres-foto-500-kb/)
- [Ubah ukuran foto](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/ubah-ukuran-foto/)
- [Ubah ukuran foto 3×4 cm](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/ubah-ukuran-foto-3x4/)
- [Ubah ukuran foto 4×6 cm](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/ubah-ukuran-foto-4x6/)
- [Crop foto online](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/crop-foto/)
- [PNG ke JPG](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/png-ke-jpg/)
- [JPG ke PNG](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/jpg-ke-png/)
- [Gabungkan Foto](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/gabungkan-foto/)
- [Ubah WebP ke JPG](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/ubah-webp-ke-jpg/)
- [HEIC ke JPG](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/heic-ke-jpg/)
- [Hapus background tanda tangan](https://toolmova.com/id/alat-gambar/hapus-background-tanda-tangan/)
- [Convertir WebP a JPG](https://toolmova.com/es/herramientas-imagen/convertir-webp-a-jpg/)
- [Convertir HEIC a JPG](https://toolmova.com/es/herramientas-imagen/convertir-heic-a-jpg/)

## Limitations

JPG compression is lossy. Size limits are verified against actual output bytes. No promise of upload acceptance or official photo compliance.
